decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The rear portion of the existing single storey rear extension shall be demolished, leaving a depth of extension of 3.65m from the original wall of the house, within 6 months of the date of this permission, and a new rear wall and window erected, in accordance with details shown on drawings no SSB/P 002 and SSB/P 03 received 3.4.02
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of part single storey rear extension, demolition of part existing single storey rear extension & erection of single storey rear extension to a depth of 3.65m
